turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in class. Start there.
So the defense is that he just types really fast?
I haven't said a word about typing. You haven't shown me anything yet.
182 words in six minutes. Wow. Maybe he should be a court stenographer.
Save the jokes for your colleagues. 182 words in six minutes, according to what, and on which date?
You asked for this meeting, Hale. Show me the document or I walk down to the principal.
